title: Generate, then verify: pairing a molecular generative model with the checks that can fail it
description: An eight-module teaching resource for molecular design that pairs a generative model with a verification check that can fail it: toy diffusion and flow-matching samplers, pocket-conditioned ligand generation checked with PoseBusters and PoseCheck, a co-folding verifier, and a transfer of the same loop to protein design. Every module runs on a laptop CPU with no GPU, API key, or download. Curriculum and prose are CC BY 4.0; the code is Apache-2.0.
